
## Summary

**Replace ambiguous UNKNOWN and generic No data** (residual after DUX5)

The screenshots use UNKNOWN, No data, VALID_EMPTY, N/A and zero for multiple incompatible meanings.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P0**
- Wave: **V1**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P0-01`
- DUX code: `DUX6-01`

## Scope

All dashboards; every status and empty-state panel.

Screenshot groups: SG-01..SG-07

## Concrete change

Introduce the canonical health/execution/evidence/applicability vocabularies. Require a reason and evidence state whenever the primary state is not self-explanatory.

## Expected effect

Operators can distinguish missing telemetry, not-started work, valid empty results and backend failures without opening panel details.

## Acceptance criteria

- No primary status card displays bare UNKNOWN or No data. Screenshot tests cover every state class.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Bounded status/reason codes from APIs or recording rules; copy mapping in interface layer.

## Risk

Incorrect mapping could hide a real incident; requires semantics review.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7117 DUX5-01 closed — residual: bare UNKNOWN still dominates without reason chip

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card
